explication: Azure SDK for Python is a collection of service-specific client and management libraries, rather than one application. A developer creates a client, authenticates, and invokes an operation against an Azure service; shared core libraries provide the HTTP pipeline and common policies. The tree also shows agent-server packages, evaluation red teaming, and Cosmos semantic reranking as distinct capabilities. The README documents the shared client and management-library roles; sampled source confirms pipeline execution and several service operations, but does not establish wiring for every package.
